paragraphs.source_en: “I came back because I wanted to help save the company. After some reflection, I knew we both needed to change, but I also knew that all I could control was me. What Lou would do was for Lou to decide.” Kate stopped talking, and Tom didn’t speak for a while. Eventually he sighed. “I don’t talk about this much, but I was laid off from my last position. I had been there for almost ten years and I thought my contributions were obvious. But apparently they weren’t. It’s eaten at me every day since.” “That you were let go?” “That they laid me off and kept Pierre. But I was doing the same sort of recruiting you were talking about, Kate. People love to hate on an arrogant supervisor.” “I know,” Kate said, smiling. “And that’s the sort of thing we can’t let happen here.” “I hear you,” Tom said. Kate was smiling. “So now what?” “What do you mean?”
